pretreatments.description: Mechanical physical pretreatment involving air drying, paper cutting, sieving (20-40 mesh), vacuum packaging, and washing with distilled water.

Chemical physical pretreatment using hydrothermal conditions with temperatures set at 125, 150, 175, and 200 °C, using distilled water and a stainless steel reactor with a Teflon vessel, with a 24-hour duration.
